name: gitmark
description: OntoShip — ontology-driven docs that ship: a md+git knowledge base (FTS5 search, HTML graph, ontology linter) plus the spec-driven dev-flow built on it. CLI/plugin: gitmark.

interface.shortDescription: md+git knowledge base with FTS5 search, an HTML graph, and a gated dev-flow
